Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِيْ فِيْهِ أَبْوَابَ الجِنَانِ
Translation: O Allah, open for me in it the doors of Paradise
And close for me in it the doors of Hellfire
And grant me success in it for the recitation of the Quran

Arabic text: يَا مُنْزِلَ السَّكِينَةِ فِيْ قُلُوبِ المُؤْمِنِيْنَ
Translation: O One who sends down tranquility into the hearts of the believers
